checks.name: Readable in 30 days
checks.reason: 30 days can detect a lift of 11.1%. You expect 20%.

checks.name: Pays back at the expected lift
checks.reason: Not run. No value was given for one click, so the success number is not tied to money.
checks.fix: Give the value of one click to test payback.

checks.name: One change
checks.reason: The test changes three things at once: the blog design, a popup and ad creative. A result cannot say which one worked.
checks.fix: Test one change. Start with the one you expect to move demos most.

checks.name: Right metric
checks.reason: Click-through rate is a click, not a step toward pipeline.
checks.fix: Measure the first number that leads to pipeline, such as newsletter sign-ups that become demo requests, or demo requests from the blog.

checks.name: Clean split
checks.reason: The site tool assigns visitors at random.
